summary: Since round 3, the only change is a new `appPaths.under()` helper in `appPaths.py`. It normalizes a path built from request values and refuses any result outside its root. `appHost.py` now uses it to build every path from the extension ID under DATA and WORKSPACE. This is defense in depth on top of the existing `app_name` check. The temp tests run the escape-refusal branch. All temp tests pass, every changed line is covered or has an accepted exemption, and no P0 or P1 finding remains.
